precepts.text: Exalt the Most High and worship at his footstool, for he is holy.
precepts.point: Holy means severed. We were severed from other people, given a set of laws contrary to all nations. Once we mingle with the other nations we become unholy.

note.label: Psalm 132: The Oath to David and the Throne Forever

precepts.why: “We will go into his tabernacles: we will worship at his footstool.” “Exalt ye the Lord our God, and worship at his footstool; for he is holy.” We come into the house of the Most High to learn his laws, to be holy, to be separate, because he is holy.

points: The Most High reigns and the people are to tremble; He sits between the cherubims and the earth is moved.

note.label: Psalm 99: The Lord Reigneth, Let the People Tremble

points: He is great in Zion and high above all the people, and His great and terrible name is to be praised, for it is holy.

note.label: Psalm 99: The Lord Reigneth, Let the People Tremble

points: The King's strength loves judgment; He establishes equity and executes judgment and righteousness in Jacob.

note.label: Psalm 99: The Lord Reigneth, Let the People Tremble

points: Israel is called to exalt the Most High and worship at His footstool, for He is holy.

note.label: Psalm 99: The Lord Reigneth, Let the People Tremble

points: Moses and Aaron among His priests, and Samuel among them that call upon His name, called upon the Most High and He answered them.
When Moses, Aaron, and Samuel called upon His name, they were keeping the commandments of the Most High. That is why they were answered.

note.label: Psalm 99: The Lord Reigneth, Let the People Tremble

points: He spoke to them in the cloudy pillar; they kept His testimonies and the ordinance He gave them.

note.label: Psalm 99: The Lord Reigneth, Let the People Tremble

points: The Most High answered them; He was a God that forgave them, though He took vengeance of their inventions.

note.label: Psalm 99: The Lord Reigneth, Let the People Tremble

points: Israel is called again to exalt the Most High and worship at His holy hill, for the Most High our God is holy.
